prompt_fragment:
This asset is an icon. Use crisp, reduced shapes, bold edges, and high readability at very small sizes.
Keep the icon silhouette bold, crisp, and readable at 16px.
raw_description:
A stylized fortified holdfast / keep. Flat app-icon geometry. One
squat square fortress tower with a crenellated / battlemented top
edge (three or four rectangular tooth-shapes), narrow rectangular
slit-window cutouts in a contrasting palette color, and a simple
gate opening at the bottom. Flat saturated palette colors, sharp
edges, clearly reading as fortification at 32px.
formatted_prompt: Flat app-icon illustration, centered on a plain off-white canvas with generous padding, no scene, no background. A single squat square fortress tower rendered in bold vivid red (#FF0000) flat fill with sharp crisp vector edges. The tower top features four rectangular crenellation teeth silhouetted cleanly against white. Two narrow vertical slit-window cutouts on the tower face filled in pure yellow (#FFFF00), high contrast against the red. A simple wide rectangular gate opening at the base filled solid black. All edges precise and deliberate, every shape a flat bold fill with zero gradients, zero brushwork, zero texture. Strong color separation between red tower, yellow slits, and black gate. Fully readable as a fortification silhouette at 16px. Modern UI icon register, Phosphor Fill aesthetic, 2026-era app design.
